1/ 先把这次前后矛盾的小作文说清楚
背景是我昨天的帖子：《这个周末我认为最重要的一件事情》 https://t.co/zEJm3WmFa2

仅凭这个周末的表态，就认定整个 AI 产业要停下来，我非常不认同，我认为有 3 点逻辑错误

2/ 三点逻辑错误
> 这个呼吁，真的能让全世界一起慢下来吗？
呼吁能落实到什么程度，本身还是个问号。不能把一个倡议，直接当成全球已经执行的决定

> 所谓“停下”，也不是明天就把机器关了，也不是放缓了对机器的需求

Dario 明确说，pacing 不意味着停止模型训练或技术进步。他希望给 alignment、安全措施和第三方评估留出足够的时间，让安全工作跟上能力进步

认为市场的错误逻辑渲染已经偏移了原意，非常外行

> Training 和 inference，又被混为一谈了
先不说这个呼吁最终会怎样影响 training。训练下一代模型，和让已经训练好的模型每天替用户写代码、查资料、跑任务，是两类工作。后面这些，就是 inference，推理

即使下一代模型的研发慢一点，已经在用 AI 的人，就不再用了？企业已经跑起来的应用，就不用继续消耗算力了？
我所见之处，仍然是算力短缺。额度不够用，算力不够用，一片鬼哭狼嚎。

我不信，一个周末的表态，就足以证明这些需求突然消失了.当然，市场也可能在担心未来增速放缓。这是需要讨论的。但从“以后可能没有原来预期增长得那么快”，跳到“现在这些算力都不需要了”，中间差得太远

3/ 下跌的真实原因是什么？
我认为市场的担心并非没有理由，一个放缓的增长足以让股价下杀，但我更认为这是为 9 月 16 号的议息决定释放风险，华尔街找个理由跌罢了

你可能会说，现在市场定价加息 25 个基点，交易概率已经到达 87%，已经 price-in 了，这个说法也没错

如果你认定了这个说法，不妨问自己一个问题：如果加息已经 price in 了大部分，而市场现在交易的逻辑又和长期理念违背，作为有耐心的长线投资者，你现在应该做什么呢？

我个人并不会把短线子弹打完。

目前我持有的仓位占现金仓位大概 45% 左右，今晚夜盘进行买入。目前看起来情绪可能继续渲染，换而言之，这可能不是最底部，但我从来不奢望自己买到最底部，我的持有时间是一年以上

quotedTweet.text:
这个周末我认为最重要的一件事情：
OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI在同一个周末集体来了表态，一致同意并呼吁放慢 AI 的发展速度……

Dario 已经在原文里点名：AI 正在越来越多地参与研发下一代 AI。他担心这种加速，会超过人类理解和控制模型的速度

OpenAI 甚至说：“如果真到了那一步，为了拯救人类，我们愿意把自己的 GPU 都熔掉。”

通常这类 frontier lab 的管理层会比我们提前看到新一代模型的能力。显然，AI 已经突破了某个临界点，而且事情严重到把所有人都吓住了

这个或许是我们过度解读了。但有一点是肯定的，无论如何呼吁，整个世界这么多 lab 一定不会完全步调统一、暂缓步伐

text:
🚨ALERTA: ACABA DE PASAR ALGO MUY SERIO

China se ha deshecho de 70.000 MILLONES de dólares en bonos del Tesoro de EE. UU.

Es su mayor venta desde la crisis financiera de 2008.

Mientras tanto, sus reservas de oro se han disparado hasta un récord de 305.000 MILLONES de dólares.

China se está preparando para un cambio ENORME en los mercados.

Pero hay algo que casi NADIE está entendiendo:

China está intentando internacionalizar el yuan utilizando ORO, nuevas infraestructuras de pago y alternativas al dólar estadounidense.

En julio de 2026, el sistema de compensación de oro respaldado por el Gobierno de Hong Kong comenzó sus operaciones de prueba.

Y está conectado directamente con la Bolsa de Oro de Shanghái.

SÍ, YA ES OFICIAL.

China está construyendo una red internacional de bóvedas de oro diseñada para reforzar el papel del yuan en el sistema financiero global.

Y esto es solo UNA parte de la estrategia.

China también está desarrollando infraestructuras de pago basadas en blockchain junto a países BRICS.

El objetivo está clarísimo:

REDUCIR LA DEPENDENCIA DEL DÓLAR ESTADOUNIDENSE.

Y el ORO está en el centro de todo.

China lleva ya MÁS DE 20 MESES CONSECUTIVOS aumentando sus reservas de oro.

Y este movimiento empieza a extenderse por todo el sistema financiero mundial:

→ China está comprando oro
→ Corea del Sur vuelve a comprar oro por primera vez en 13 AÑOS
→ Algunos países están reduciendo su exposición a bonos del Tesoro de EE. UU.
→ La exposición al oro está aumentando
→ Las estrategias de reservas globales están cambiando

Esto ya no parece un movimiento aislado.

Estamos viendo un cambio que afecta a MÚLTIPLES grandes economías.

Y las implicaciones pueden ser enormes.

El oro ha superado a los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense en peso dentro de determinadas métricas de reservas globales.

Incluso Venezuela está moviendo sus reservas de oro valoradas en 4.000 MILLONES de dólares y unas 31 toneladas fuera de Londres después de 8 AÑOS.

Los países no solo están comprando más oro.

ESTÁN MOVIENDO SUS RESERVAS.

Están cambiando dónde las almacenan.

Están cambiando cómo liquidan sus transacciones.

Y están construyendo alternativas al sistema financiero dominado por el dólar.

La cadena empieza a ser difícil de ignorar:

Más oro → Menos Treasuries → Menor dependencia del dólar → Más sistemas de pago alternativos → NUEVA ESTRUCTURA FINANCIERA

China no está simplemente comprando oro.

ESTÁ CONSTRUYENDO TODA UNA INFRAESTRUCTURA FINANCIERA ALREDEDOR DE ÉL.

Y si más países siguen el mismo camino, la presión para reducir la dependencia global del dólar podría acelerarse.

Así es como cambian los sistemas financieros globales.

No ocurre de la noche a la mañana.

Primero sucede poco a poco.

Y después, de repente.

PRESTAD ATENCIÓN.

Porque cuando la mayoría se dé cuenta de lo que está pasando, el movimiento podría llevar años desarrollándose.

Llevo más de 10 años siguiendo los mercados y Bitcoin.

China se está preparando para un cambio ENORME en los mercados.

Pero hay algo que casi NADIE está entendiendo:

China está intentando internacionalizar el yuan utilizando ORO, nuevas infraestructuras de pago y alternativas al dólar estadounidense.

Y está conectado directamente con la Bolsa de Oro de Shanghái.

SÍ, YA ES OFICIAL.

China está construyendo una red internacional de bóvedas de oro diseñada para reforzar el papel del yuan en el sistema financiero global.

Y esto es solo UNA parte de la estrategia.

China también está desarrollando infraestructuras de pago basadas en blockchain junto a países BRICS.

El objetivo está clarísimo:

REDUCIR LA DEPENDENCIA DEL DÓLAR ESTADOUNIDENSE.

Y el ORO está en el centro de todo.

China lleva ya MÁS DE 20 MESES CONSECUTIVOS aumentando sus reservas de oro.

Y este movimiento empieza a extenderse por todo el sistema financiero mundial:

text:
SHE GETS COVERED BY STRANGERS TWICE AND STILL COMES BACK UNCHANGED

This looks like a regular POV clip from a busy carnival booth. Stuffed bears are hanging above, people are moving through the crowd, and she is standing at the counter paying with her phone.

Then the real stress test happens.

A man holding a kid walks directly in front of the camera and completely hides her. A few seconds later, another woman with a child and another man pass through the same frame and block her again.

Both times, she vanishes from the shot.

And both times, she returns exactly the same: same position, same stance, still mid-payment, phone in the same hand at the same angle.

This is where AI video usually starts to fall apart.

Keeping a subject stable when nothing blocks them is easy. The difficult part is when someone crosses the lens and the model has to bring back what was hidden without changing the face, hands, clothes, pose, timing or objects.

Here, nothing obvious breaks.

No face shift. No hand glitch. No outfit change. No phone jumping. No weird reset after the camera gets blocked.

And the craziest part is that none of this was real.

Not the carnival booth. Not the stuffed bears. Not the strangers crossing the shot at exactly the right time.

That is why this clip works so well. AI is no longer just making clean pretty frames. It is starting to keep continuity through chaotic, real-world movement.

text:
再分享一个谷歌面经：
谷歌面试拒绝 

我在11月14日申请了一个L3软件工程师职位，11月22日，招聘人员联系我安排面试。
电话筛选定在12月11日。题目是一个简单到中等难度的问题，进展得还算不错。第二天招聘人员通知我，反馈是积极的，倾向于录用，花2-3周的时间准备现场面试。
评估 - 录用
由于假期原因，现场面试被延迟，3个现场面试和一个总监面试定于1月27日、28日，2月6日和10日进行。
现场面试1 - 这是一个基于Trie和回溯的难题。我在提供暴力解法后立刻想到了Trie的思路。我在回溯部分卡住了，面试官说最后再来做。实现Trie部分耗费了不少时间，我在完成回溯部分的编码时时间紧迫。时间不够，面试官只是问了我的直觉，我向他解释了。他似乎满意。
自我评估 - 倾向于录用
现场面试2 - 一个基于哈希表的中等偏难的问题。开始是用Dijkstra方法，这是一个O(n log n)的解法。面试官给了一些提示，朝着更优的方案，我很快在提供的提示下找到了优化解法。面试官给了反馈，说我的思路很好，能够迅速在提示下找到优化方案。这一轮有2个后续问题，我能解决所有后续问题。
自我评估 - 强烈推荐录用
现场面试3 - 又是一个基于哈希的中等偏难问题。最初给出了O(n)的解决方案，面试官满意。作为后续，面试官要求比O(n)更优的解法。我在没有任何提示的情况下，迅速给出了O(log n)的解决方案。又作为另外一个后续问题，面试官要求进一步优化O(n log n)，我快速提供了O(1)的解法，没有任何提示。面试官似乎很着急，不知道为什么，但他满意。

自我评估 - 倾向于录用

自我评估 - 强烈推荐录用

自我评估 - 强烈推荐录用
总监面试 - 网络上有一些标准问题，我像大家提到的一样使用了STAR方法。面试完成得比预期快，面试官问了几个额外问题，因为还有很多时间。

GPT-6 Astra + TradingView builds the most powerful trading agents

i plugged this open source repo into my Astra stack & now my 24/7 trading bot works with real-time TradingView data

PREMIUM indicators without paying for a PRO account

here is how you can set it up:

1. clone the TradingView API repo (3.9k stars, github on top), one npm install gets you real-time feeds, premium indicators and replay mode

2. pipe the live data stream into the 300 agent monitoring layer, each sub-agent now pulls TradingView values on top of exchange APIs, 10x the signal coverage without extra cost

3. expose the indicator library as a tool to GPT-6 Astra. RSI, MACD, Ichimoku, Supertrend, plus any custom Pine Script indicator you can pull from TradingView, all callable natively

4. use the backtest endpoint to validate every hypothesis. Astra writes the strategy, converts to Pine Script, ships it, reads the result in seconds

5. connect the technical analysis endpoint to the Validation Bot. TradingView returns a buy/sell/neutral read across 26 indicators for any symbol, becomes a second opinion layer before capital moves

6. use replay mode to stress test across any timeframe. free, unlimited, works on premium data

7. telegram alerts now include chart snapshots alongside instrument, strategy, Sharpe, drawdown and Kelly sized position

EXACT system (in depth) which I am running with GPT-6 Astra is in the article below:

text:
这是真实故事：

她是从大连来的女孩，在 Nordstrom 做 sales。

最初只是因为她给我提供了很好的服务，几年下来渐渐熟悉，后来成了朋友。生活、工作，甚至找男朋友，她都会来问我。

那时她年收入已经超过7万美元，却几乎没有存款。每年回大连给父母亲友买礼物、给父母买车，平时下班又常和朋友去酒吧吃饭。

我问她：“上班已经这么累，为什么下班不回家休息？”

她说了一句话，我一直记得：“上班忙的时候还好，一下班我就不敢回出租屋。太孤独了，感觉人像走在气球上，没有着落，不踏实。”

我说：“既然这么没有着落，为什么不买一个真正属于自己的家？”

2010年，我建议她买房。她没有头款，我无息借给她。

22.7万美元，她买下了一套靠近 Longo Toyota 的三层 condo，三房、双车库。

搬进去还不到一个月，她突然打电话给我：被 Nordstrom 辞退了。

公司活动时，客人替她拿了一杯含酒精的饮料，她只是闻了一下，却被其他员工举报上班喝酒。第二天，她就被辞退了。

她是店里的 top sales，事情来得太突然。

刚刚买房，又突然没了工资，她一下慌了：“房贷怎么办？”

我说：“这不还有我吗？”

我又借给她一万美元：“够你撑半年。三间房先租一间给女留学生，自己赶快找工作。”

不到十天，她就在 South Coast Plaza 的 Bloomingdale’s 找到了新工作。

后来，她一路做到品牌经理，也结婚了，先生是建筑设计师，还把妈妈接到了美国。借我的钱，也早已全部还清。

这些年，母亲节、生日、感恩节、春节，她送给我的礼物从来没有断过。

我60岁那年，她竟然给了我一个600美元的红包🧧

拿到红包的时候，我特别感动。
也许是太多年没有人给我红包了😂

当年那个下班后不敢回出租屋、觉得自己“像走在气球上”的女孩，如今有了自己的房子、事业、丈夫，妈妈也在身边。

我并没有替她改变人生。只是在她想落地的时候，帮她垫了一块可以踩住的地方；刚刚站稳又突然跌下去的时候，再托了她一把。

后来的人生，都是她自己走出来的。

帮助一个人，最有意义的不是给她多少，而是在她人生最关键的节点，托她一把，让她有机会靠自己的力量，把命运重新接起来🌟🍾💐

text:
fun fact: the muse feed was my idea (one of the few things that was) after realizing agents with strong memory recommend content to you in a very different way than existing recommendation systems

they’re much closer to a good friend sending you things they think you might like based on what they knows about you, vs a slew of content related to what you just clicked.

it’s just the beginning here, but very excited for people to try their muse feeds and see what they do with it!

quotedTweet.text:
What I like most about Muse, besides the personal-agent support, is the Feed. 

Recommender systems learn from indirect signals and then decide what to show you. 

Muse flips that: you tell the system what to look for, so the experience feels completely different. I get more control over what I actually want to learn and fry my brain with each day, and less of the noise recommendation systems usually serve. 

It’s been working really well for me so far, and pairing the Feed with the agent features makes it even more useful.

text:
GPT-6 Astra is the most powerful engine for building multi-agent systems.

i wrote a 12-page research paper on how to build a one-person hedge fund that runs 24/7 using Astra.

Here is the full architecture:

300 parallel agents monitoring equities, perps, options flow, SEC filings, X accounts, and macro calendar at once

• Monitoring swarm: filters thousands of signals down to 10-30 candidates per day. Everything else gets thrown out

• Hypothesis agent: generates a structured thesis for each candidate: instrument, edge, catalyst, invalidation

• Backtest agent: writes Python, runs 5 years of data. Gate: Sharpe > 1.5, drawdown < 15%

• Validation agent: checks statistical significance, out-of-sample on last 12 months, regime dependence, transaction costs. Bull-market-only strategies get killed

• Deployment agent: sends to broker, telegram pings your phone: confidence, Sharpe, position size

• Risk agent: runs independently. 5% drawdown from peak = all positions close. No override

This 12-page PDF changed how I think about systematic trading.

Read it now, then explore the article below to learn how to build a multi-agent trading desk with Astra using real cases.

兄弟们，早上刷 GitHub 给我刷麻了。

榜首挂着个叫 WiFi-DensePose 的开源项目，点进去看完我人愣了三秒。

它说啥呢——光靠 WiFi 信号，就能把你人在屋里的动作姿势给还原出来。不用摄像头、不用传感器、不用任何特殊硬件。

我第一反应：吹的吧？结果往下翻，真有人跑出 demo 了，那骨架还原得还挺像那么回事。

最离谱的是这玩意儿理论上能隔墙感知。意思就是你搁客厅躺着玩手机，门外的人拿台设备就能知道你人形轮廓在哪、手在干嘛。

我靠，这要是真落地，住酒店和出租屋的兄弟们晚上睡觉怕是要先把 WiFi 关了。

源码在这，想验证的自己扒：https://t.co/D3eVO7ebOu

反正我是睡不着了。

text:
我哥刚上班那会儿，住的是单身宿舍。

因为男女共用一个洗衣间，所以里面经常挂满了各种女士内衣。那时候大家都习以为常，洗完衣服往墙上一挂，谁也不管是谁的。

有一天，他一个人在洗衣间洗衣服，旁边晾着的一件红色胸罩突然掉到了地上。

他当时没注意，一脚踩了上去。

等他低头看见时，红色胸罩上已经留下了一个清晰的鞋印。

他赶紧捡起来，想着帮人家洗干净再挂回去。结果刚把它拿到水龙头旁边，几个女同事就进来了，开始收自己的衣服。

当时他手里正拿着那件红色胸罩，扔也不是，解释也不是，脑子一热，直接把它塞进了自己的衣服里，装作若无其事地走出了洗衣间。

回到宿舍后，他坐在床边，做了很久的心理斗争。

洗干净挂回去吧，怕被人误会。

直接扔掉吧，又觉得缺德。

最后他还是趁着半夜，等宿舍楼里没人，在一片漆黑中把那件胸罩丢进了楼下的大垃圾桶。

那段时间他一直觉得挺内疚，后来日子一忙，也就慢慢忘了。

没想到十几年后，前两天晚上，我嫂子突然跟他聊天，说起她刚上班那会儿住单身宿舍的事。

她说，当年她买过一件特别贵的红色胸罩，洗完后挂在宿舍洗衣间，结果没过多久就不见了。

她到现在都不知道，是哪个变态把它偷走的。

我哥听完这句话，后背一下就凉了。

我嫂子看着我哥问：你怎么了？

我哥说没事，就是突然觉得，这个世界有时候真的挺小。

As more teams ran voice isolation in front of their STT, we started seeing a subtle problem: on the hardest segments with most multi-speaker overlap, the model was removing too much signal which was resulting in WER degradation.

Voice Isolation 2.5 fixes that. 
Across 10 STT engines from 7 vendors we saw:
– 46.4% fewer word errors
– 69.7% fewer on background speech, the hardest case there is
– No harm on clean audio. An important update from previous VI 2.1 model
– A 3.5x smaller version, comparable results

Full details: https://t.co/1Z7xcBMgiP

your CLAUDE.md is probably full of rules written for models that no longer need them, and every one of them is charged on every request:

> blanket bans like never add comments, replaced by match the surrounding code
> examples in tool descriptions, now narrowing the model instead of helping it
> everything loaded upfront, instead of skills that load when the situation shows up
> the same instruction sitting in the system prompt and on the tool

6 shifts total, and the first pass is deletion, not rewriting.

run /doctor in your LLM and it audits your files against all of it.

full docs below.

quotedTweet.text:
Any pursuit of superintelligence has to be grounded in the core principle that if the AI we build is not helping humanity and under human control, it's not worth pursuing.

We also need to accelerate and spread the benefits of AI, such that they are diffused broadly across countries, communities, and companies. This requires a frontier ecosystem in which both closed and open-source models can thrive.

And for firms, it’s imperative that they retain full control over their unique and tacit knowledge. Every organization should be able to build its own continuous learning loop/hill climbing machine, without becoming dependent on any one model provider, and have the ability to embed its own knowledge into models and weights they control.

So, in this context, we welcome the research, focus, and deliberate pacing needed to get alignment right as the design goal. We also welcome ideas like "embedded evaluators" and the broader efforts to develop the mechanisms to make this more than just talk.

The key is that this cannot be controlled by a handful of entities, but must have broad representation across the ecosystem, countries, and fields, including academia.

This is the approach we are taking: broad access and choice at every layer of the AI stack; enterprise control of learning loops and models; and the “Code of Conduct” that underlies our own first party MAI models that we’ll publish tomorrow for public consultation.

我以前以为GPT代充这门生意特别简单。

无非就是：客户给钱，你帮他充，赚个差价。

后来跟做渠道的人聊，才发现这种生意最有意思的地方：

假设一个散户代理一天接10单，每单最后留下30块，一天300。

听起来不错。

但他要自己回消息、解释流程、处理付款失败、催客户、做售后。晚上十一点有人来一句：

“哥，怎么掉了？”

他还得爬起来看。

再往上一层的人，玩法就变了。

他不一定自己找10个客户。

他可能找20个这样的小代理。

假设每单只从渠道里留10块，每个代理每天出10单：

20 × 10 × 10 = 2000块。

当然这只是用来说明渠道结构的算术例子，现实还要扣大量成本。

但它让我重新理解了一件事：

很多人看见一个赚钱项目，第一反应都是：

“我怎么做？”

做久一点的人会问：

“谁已经有100个人在做？”

前者研究怎么接单。

后者研究怎么成为那100个人共同经过的地方。

所以很多所谓“副业”，最下面的人卖时间，中间的人卖流量，再上面的人卖渠道。

大家看起来都在做同一门生意，赚的压根不是同一种钱。

GPT代充只是其中一个特别容易看懂的缩影。

真正让人眼红的，通常也不是一单赚多少，是有多少单必须从你这里经过。

Any pursuit of superintelligence has to be grounded in the core principle that if the AI we build is not helping humanity and under human control, it's not worth pursuing.

We also need to accelerate and spread the benefits of AI, such that they are diffused broadly across countries, communities, and companies. This requires a frontier ecosystem in which both closed and open-source models can thrive.

And for firms, it’s imperative that they retain full control over their unique and tacit knowledge. Every organization should be able to build its own continuous learning loop/hill climbing machine, without becoming dependent on any one model provider, and have the ability to embed its own knowledge into models and weights they control.

So, in this context, we welcome the research, focus, and deliberate pacing needed to get alignment right as the design goal. We also welcome ideas like "embedded evaluators" and the broader efforts to develop the mechanisms to make this more than just talk.

The key is that this cannot be controlled by a handful of entities, but must have broad representation across the ecosystem, countries, and fields, including academia.

This is the approach we are taking: broad access and choice at every layer of the AI stack; enterprise control of learning loops and models; and the “Code of Conduct” that underlies our own first party MAI models that we’ll publish tomorrow for public consultation.

text:
敬一丹去世，这一次的消息应当是真的。那么，有一件往事也就可以公开了。

大概是1993年的夏天，我第一次坐牢出来没多久。有一次参加北京三味书屋的活动，遇到敬一丹和她带的摄影师。她见到我很热情，并现场做了一次专访。要知道，此时的敬一丹，还是央视的记者。

访谈的内容我已经忘记了，但我当时很惊讶她的胆大，问她“这个能播吗”？她也笑着说：当然不能播，但她想先留个记录。我懂她的意思：早晚还是可以播出的。

那是1993年，中国刚刚从“六四”的红色恐怖中稍微走出来一点。不管是否播出，敬一丹愿意做这个访谈，已经是很有勇气了，也代表她心中对“六四”这件事的态度。当时的央视，出过薛飞，出过杜宪，敬一丹的态度，倒也不令人意外。考虑到她在国内，这件事我以前一直没说过。现在应该可以了。

我不认识敬一丹，也不知道她后来有什么样的发展。但在那个肃杀的年代，敬一丹的那个访谈，让我感受到温暖。

仅凭这一点，我要向敬一丹致意，祝她在天堂平安🙏

text:
如果你想做 AI 应用，不妨考虑一下Harness开发。从我实际工作经验出发，我把相关能力整理成了一份11 条技能清单，欢迎收藏、保存，和 AI 一起学习，提升认知

完整 List：
1. 后端与系统设计：让请求进得来、状态存得住，出错后能恢复。
2. RAG、Embeddings 与向量数据库：RAG 是先找资料再回答；Embedding 把内容变成表示语义的数列，向量库帮助查找相似内容。
3. 记忆与上下文管理：记忆保存以后要用的信息，上下文管理决定这一轮给模型看什么。
4. 工具调用与 MCP CLI：工具让系统执行动作，MCP 是连接 AI 应用与外部工具、资料的一套通用协议。
5. Agent 与工作流模式编排：Agent 让模型根据结果决定下一步，工作流则按预先写好的步骤执行。
6. 护栏与确定性校验：用程序检查输入、输出和操作权限，把关键业务规则落到执行处。
7. 评测：评测检查事情有没有做对
8. 可观测性：日志记事件，指标看整体，追踪串起一次任务走过的步骤，出错才能找到原因。
9. 模型路由与降级：按任务选模型，调用失败时切换经过验证的备用方案。
10. 排队与负载均衡：控制多少任务同时运行，再把任务分给有余力的服务。
11. 推理部署与引擎：推理是模型生成结果的过程；本地或云端决定在哪里跑，vLLM、TensorRT-LLM、SGLang 等引擎负责高效运行模型。

如果你关注了 9月 10 日的 YC Demo Day，你会发现很多项目都在面向特定业务做 Harness。这个在硅谷是非常火的方向，就是围绕模型搭起来，让它拿到资料、调用工具、遵守规则、检查结果

普通开发者学习 AI 其实可以先从 AI 应用入手，学会把模型接进一个具体业务，把一件事从头到尾做成，我给大家整理了一套技能清单和地图，你可以直接把这个帖子丢给 AI，并给它prompt: “

先判断我已经会什么，再用一个实际的例子带我学这份清单。每次只加一个能力：解释它解决什么问题，让我动手实现，再给我一个会失败的测试。确认我理解了，再去下一站”

完整 YC summer 26 batch list 链接
https://t.co/ux5p5hQ7b5

如果你想做 AI 应用，不妨考虑一下Harness开发。从我实际工作经验出发，我把相关能力整理成了一份11 条技能清单，欢迎收藏、保存，和 AI 一起学习，提升认知

完整 List：
1. 后端与系统设计：让请求进得来、状态存得住，出错后能恢复。
2. RAG、Embeddings 与向量数据库：RAG 是先找资料再回答；Embedding 把内容变成表示语义的数列，向量库帮助查找相似内容。
3. 记忆与上下文管理：记忆保存以后要用的信息，上下文管理决定这一轮给模型看什么。
4. 工具调用与 MCP CLI：工具让系统执行动作，MCP 是连接 AI 应用与外部工具、资料的一套通用协议。
5. Agent 与工作流模式编排：Agent 让模型根据结果决定下一步，工作流则按预先写好的步骤执行。
6. 护栏与确定性校验：用程序检查输入、输出和操作权限，把关键业务规则落到执行处。
7. 评测：评测检查事情有没有做对
8. 可观测性：日志记事件，指标看整体，追踪串起一次任务走过的步骤，出错才能找到原因。
9. 模型路由与降级：按任务选模型，调用失败时切换经过验证的备用方案。
10. 排队与负载均衡：控制多少任务同时运行，再把任务分给有余力的服务。
11. 推理部署与引擎：推理是模型生成结果的过程；本地或云端决定在哪里跑，vLLM、TensorRT-LLM、SGLang 等引擎负责高效运行模型。

如果你关注了 9月 10 日的 YC Demo Day，你会发现很多项目都在面向特定业务做 Harness。这个在硅谷是非常火的方向，就是围绕模型搭起来，让它拿到资料、调用工具、遵守规则、检查结果

普通开发者学习 AI 其实可以先从 AI 应用入手，学会把模型接进一个具体业务，把一件事从头到尾做成，我给大家整理了一套技能清单和地图，你可以直接把这个帖子丢给 AI，并给它prompt: “

先判断我已经会什么，再用一个实际的例子带我学这份清单。每次只加一个能力：解释它解决什么问题，让我动手实现，再给我一个会失败的测试。确认我理解了，再去下一站”

完整 YC summer 26 batch list 链接

quotedTweet.text:
Any pursuit of superintelligence has to be grounded in the core principle that if the AI we build is not helping humanity and under human control, it's not worth pursuing.

We also need to accelerate and spread the benefits of AI, such that they are diffused broadly across countries, communities, and companies. This requires a frontier ecosystem in which both closed and open-source models can thrive.

And for firms, it’s imperative that they retain full control over their unique and tacit knowledge. Every organization should be able to build its own continuous learning loop/hill climbing machine, without becoming dependent on any one model provider, and have the ability to embed its own knowledge into models and weights they control.

So, in this context, we welcome the research, focus, and deliberate pacing needed to get alignment right as the design goal. We also welcome ideas like "embedded evaluators" and the broader efforts to develop the mechanisms to make this more than just talk.

The key is that this cannot be controlled by a handful of entities, but must have broad representation across the ecosystem, countries, and fields, including academia.

This is the approach we are taking: broad access and choice at every layer of the AI stack; enterprise control of learning loops and models; and the “Code of Conduct” that underlies our own first party MAI models that we’ll publish tomorrow for public consultation.

Every organization should be able to build its own continuous learning loop/hill climbing machine, without becoming dependent on any one model provider, and have the ability to embed its own knowledge into models and weights they control.

So, in this context, we welcome the research, focus, and deliberate pacing needed to get alignment right as the design goal. We also welcome ideas like "embedded evaluators" and the broader efforts to develop the mechanisms to make this more than just talk.

The key is that this cannot be controlled by a handful of entities, but must have broad representation across the ecosystem, countries, and fields, including academia.

This is the approach we are taking: broad access and choice at every layer of the AI stack; enterprise control of learning loops and models; and the “Code of Conduct” that underlies our own first party MAI models that we’ll publish tomorrow for public consultation.

text:
I am traveling as I type this. Headed towards Japan and it’s rather emotional. It is the culmination of everything I’ve experienced in my life up to this point. From a far, Japan, this tiny little island of a country, has influenced my entire life in profound ways. From childhood to adulthood. 

I have never told this story before. 

When I was nine years old, we were poor and homeless. We had no bed, no home, no nothing. My single mother of three kids was savvy and found a kind older lady who took us in temporarily. We stayed with this woman in her home for a few weeks, maybe months. Pokemon Gold version just launched around this time. While having nothing, my mother somehow managed to get me Pokemon Gold Version for my old gameboy. My birthday was November 16th and Gold Version came out on the 21st so she somehow scrounged together enough money for a birthday present. I recall a vivid memory of sitting in a tiny corner of this woman’s house with my gameboy. I was scared and shy being in the home of a stranger, and a place that felt foreign. I’m sitting in this corner, I’m playing Gold Version on my gameboy and suddenly all of these problems in life melted away and I was having the time of my life. It was bliss. It was happiness. In a moment of struggle and life challenge, I think back at that time and my brain feeds me happy thoughts. My brain forgets the struggle and remembers the joy that Pokemon gave me. I’ve always had a bad memory but perhaps I should be thanking it for its selection of good memories. And this memory of sitting in a corner playing Gold is one of my oldest ones I’ve been luckily enough to recall. 

Red and Blue versions were amazing — but Gold Version felt like the next leap. It was magic. And it brought me so much joy. 

Throughout my entire life — I have stories like that where Japan 🇯🇵 dipped its magic into my life and makes me profoundly happy. 

Japan — I love you. ❤️

我去！终于有人把股票缠论画线做成打开就能看的图了

这个项目我愿意叫它懒人神器，缠论自动画线工具，壹缠，不用装 Python，就自动画出笔/段/中枢，A股/港美股/期货/币圈全覆盖！

以前用缠论看盘，要么自己装 Python 框架写代码，要么在图上手动画笔段中枢。

壹缠不一样，一个网页，实时自动分解走势、画线标中枢，还能逐 K 回放复盘。

核心能力：

1️⃣ 自动画笔、段和走势：实时根据 K 线递归分解结构，不需要自己一笔一笔手动画

2️⃣ 自动识别中枢：不同级别中枢直接显示在图表上，并标出上下沿

3️⃣ MACD 面积辅助：笔、段、走势都可以结合对应 MACD 面积判断背驰和力度变化

4️⃣ 多级别联立：可以把不同周期放在一起判断走势，寻找一、二、三类买卖点

5️⃣ K 线回放：支持暂停、前进、后退，比较适合拿历史行情练缠论和复盘

6️⃣ 自定义量化脚本：开放 K 线、Tick、笔段、中枢、买卖点等接口，可以自己写策略、画指标和做 Webhook 信号提醒

7️⃣ 覆盖多个市场：沪深股票、港美股、国内期货和加密货币都支持

我比较喜欢它的一点是：GitHub 主要是手册。想先把股票走势结构看清楚，再决定要不要写脚本。

缠论党不想写代码、就想快速看走势画线的，这个项目是首选。

https://t.co/4kV8SmSmNp

text:
The Hidden Bill Behind the $5,000 Promise
A tax cut, a dividend, and a campaign slogan all point to the same problem: politicians promising cash today while sending voters the bill tomorrow.
There are only two honest ways to improve the nation’s books: spend less or make more. Everything else is political stagecraft with a hidden invoice. That is why the latest pitch is so shameless: last year’s tax cuts, timed to sweeten refunds in an election year, now come paired with talk of a $5,000 “Trump Dividend” if Republicans keep Congress. It is not a plan. It is a cash-for-comfort promise dressed up as economics, with no serious commitment to restraint, revenue, or growth.
The tax cut is the more respectable con. It sounds like earned money staying with the people who made it, while the dividend looks more plainly like what it is: an election-year handout. But accounting is immune to spin, The government is simply pumping more money into the economy and not paying for it, they are daring prices not to notice. When that extra demand collides with limited groceries, housing, labor, and services, prices do not negotiate. They climb.
The math exposes the stunt. A $5,000 payment to 250 million adult citizens would cost about $1.25 trillion. One outside tax analysis estimated new tariff revenue at about $125 billion in 2027, one-tenth of the price tag. That is not a funding plan; it is a rounding error with a platform. Pile it on top of already deficit-financed tax cuts, and the result is not populism, not strategy, and certainly not discipline. It is a larger national tab with better campaign copy.
The politics are crude because they work: voters feel the check now and meet the debt later. The economics are brutal because they do not care who wins the news cycle. Borrowed handouts do not build houses, stock shelves, expand payrolls, or raise productivity. They only move the pain offstage until it returns as inflation, interest costs, or taxes. A serious governing party would ask voters to face tradeoffs. This package insults them by pretending there are none.
If Washington wants to buy applause with borrowed money, voters should at least demand to see the receipt.
